summary: Pharmacy and lab for Nabd, built as two core modules (`pharmacy`, `lab`) that run inside a clinic or hospital and are also sold as standalone editions (facility type + entitlement on the same Core, not separate services). Pharmacy closes the P0 safety hole first (prescription-only items sold over the counter, QA-14), then makes the module the single writer of stock, adds batches/FEFO/expiry, e-Rx dispense in under 20 s, partial dispense and substitution, statutory registers (H1/X, NDPS and GCC controlled drugs), purchasing with GRN and payables, reports, refills, the standalone edition with offline billing, and KSA Wasfaty/SFDA RSD. Lab adds a catalogue, digital orders from the consult (< 10 s), barcoded samples (< 60 s), results with ranges and delta checks, pathologist validation, critical-value escalation (ack < 15 min), secure report release, HIE sharing, HL7/ASTM analysers, Westgard QC, outsourcing and a lab-only edition. 58 stories, 387 engineer-days, against 265 tracker days for the 17 in-scope tasks; the difference is scope the brief adds that has no tracker task (pharmacist verification, substitution, NDPS/GCC registers, payables, network e-Rx, QC, outsourcing, HIE release, lab catalogue/ranges/validation as separate deliverables). All in-house pharmacy and lab features sit behind mode and entitlement gates so founder decisions DEC-32 (pharmacy sequencing) and DEC-30 (lab persona) change release flags, not code.

stories.title: Counter refuses to sell a prescription-only item unless it is linked to a signed prescription
stories.story: As a pharmacist (or the receptionist who dispenses in a hybrid clinic) I want the counter sale and the visit checkout to refuse any prescription-only line that is not linked to a signed prescription line so that we never hand out alprazolam or antibiotics over the counter by mistake.
stories.context: QA-14 / MF-50 (S2, clinical safety, hazard H-04): `charge_catalogue.is_rx` is stored but nothing on the billing path reads it. `CheckoutService.otcCheckout` -> `resolvePharmacyLines` (CheckoutService.java:283-300) only checks `active`, so `POST /v1/billing/otc-checkout` with an is_rx item returns 201 and decrements stock. Visit checkout also never reconciles dispensed pharmacy lines against the signed Rx. Fix: every is_rx line must carry a `prescriptionItemId` that points to a signed prescription line of the same tenant, the same patient, with remaining quantity. OTC sale of an is_rx item is blocked outright until PHL-020 (paper/photo Rx capture) adds the outside-prescription path. Non-Rx items (cosmeceuticals, dental kits, PHR-12) are unaffected. This must ship before any real patient data (P0) because hybrid mode is already live.

stories.title: Pharmacy module becomes the only writer of stock
stories.story: As an engineer I want all stock changes to go through a `StockCommands` port in the pharmacy module so that billing, dispensing, returns and purchases cannot drift apart and the batch model can replace the integer safely.

stories.title: Dispense picks the earliest-expiring batch and blocks expired stock
stories.story: As a pharmacist I want the system to pick the earliest-expiring usable batch for every line (FEFO) and to refuse expired batches so that we sell old stock first and never hand out an expired medicine.
